name: Month-end close checklist
summary: Before the month ends, your controller holds the whole close on one page: every task with its owner, its date and what it waits on, the chain that sets the close date, and each gap already written as a question. Entries are prepared for approval, never posted.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own rules for prepared work: the organization's own list as the only authority, every gap written as a question for a named role, and a person who approves, posts and locks.

sources.contribution: The stages of a close in order (cut-off, entries, reconciliations, comparison with the prior period, the pack, sign-off, lock) and the check, before the period is locked, of which tasks are not yet complete.
The day-by-day arrangement of close work counted from the period end, the idea that each task waits on named earlier tasks, and a status for each task with a note on what blocks it.
Counting the close in working days, finding the dependent chain that sets how long the close takes, and raising a late or blocked task on that chain the same day.
